This posting is for December 2026 New Graduate opportunities.
  
  
IMEG is hiring a Mechanical Engineering New Graduate in Raleigh, NC to work closely with experienced engineers and consultants to provide engineering solutions and advice to clients. This entry-level role offers hands-on design, analysis, and project execution experience supporting mechanical systems for the vertical building industry.
  
  
In this role, you will support project planning, scheduling, documentation, quality control, and multidisciplinary coordination while working within project budgets and client expectations. You will contribute to education and government/municipal projects while supporting high-performance, energy-efficient design aligned with MEP2050 and AIA2030.

**What You'll Do**

* Assist in engineering analysis, design, and implementation oversight of mechanical systems for the vertical building industry.
* Assist in the design and analysis of HVAC, plumbing and fire protection systems.
* Create detailed designs, specifications, and calculations using engineering software and tools according to code requirements and IMEG standards.
* Interact with clients to gather project requirements and communicate technical information effectively.
* Build and maintain client relationships through professional communication.
* Support the execution of consulting projects as part of a project team, while assisting with project planning and scheduling to meet deadlines and objectives.
* Document design decisions and client instructions while monitoring project design progress.
* Analyze low to medium complexity engineering tasks and collaborate with senior engineers and consultants to develop practical and efficient solutions.
* Participate in IMEG quality control processes to ensure designs and solutions meet IMEG quality standards, industry standards and client requirements.
* Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in mechanical engineering, and contribute to research, development, and innovation efforts within IMEG.
* Prioritize safety in all aspects of engineering work and help identify and mitigate potential safety risks associated with mechanical systems.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including other engineers, architects, and project managers, while working within the project’s monetary budget to meet project goals and client expectations.
